item: Sources an imported history disagrees with are re-checked first by the install itself (diagnostics rank 14, C52, PR 3)
status: SHIPPED (field effect appears at each instance's next boot and pass)
summary: A verdict measured here that an imported history disagrees with is never changed by it (rule 12 = b), but a copied-in attempt resets the re-verification clock, so the install's own re-check came a whole interval later. The boot now lists those sources (app_state key qualification.recheck_first, either direction, first flagged_at kept, dropped when no longer inverted, an unreadable stored list skips the step) and run_qualification_pass takes them ahead of its two pools within its existing per-pass re-check budget: at most half the slots, the odd slot alternating with the ordinary queue, least recently tried first by the entry's own last_tried_at, unused slots returned, budget 0 switches it off. No verdict changes. The Settings queue view shows how many are checked first (2 strings x 12 locales). Seventeen tests; each rule fails its test when removed.
